question: For 6 innings, a cricketer had an average of 90 runs. In the 7th inning, he scored 157 runs. His average score increased by _______. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total runs in 6 innings = 6 × 90 = 540

After 7th inning ⇒ total = 540 + 157 = 697

New average = 697 ÷ 7 ≈ 99.57

Increase = 99.57 − 90 ≈ 9.57 ≈ 10

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 6 innings = 90

7th inning score = 157

**Formula used:**

Total runs = Average × number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 6 × 90 = 540

⇒ Total runs in 7 innings = 540 + 157 = 697

⇒ New average = 697 ÷ 7 = 99.57

⇒ Increase in average = 99.57 − 90 = 9.57 ≈ 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

Average = Total ÷ Number

New Average

Add new value and divide by updated count

Rounding

Round to nearest whole number

Key Insight

Work with totals first, then find average
